However, if the war prolongs, we might need it. Alternatively, we could switch to a policy that gives immediate happiness or defense. But we cannot change policy until we accumulate enough culture (19 turns). So the policy selection is less relevant for the immediate crisis.
Our main concerns:
1. Defend Tenochtitlan at all costs. We need to reinforce it. We have a Heavy Bomber in Damascus that can be used to bomb enemy stacks. We have an Atomic Bomb finishing in 2 turns in Baghdad. That could be used to wipe out the enemy stack near Tenochtitlan if it's concentrated. However, using nukes has ethical implications and also will cause severe diplomatic backlash. But we are already at war with everyone, and we need to survive. We might consider using the atomic bomb if it saves the city.
2. Ensure Mecca is ready to build Citizen Earth Protocol as soon as the tech is available. According to economy briefing, Mecca is the only city with high enough production. It is currently building a Heavy Bomber (2 turns left). After that, we should set it to build the wonder immediately, but we need the tech. Our research path: Satellites (13 turns) -> The Internet -> Nanotechnology -> Particle Physics -> Globalization -> Robotics -> Future Tech. That's many techs, each taking probably 5-10 turns. We have great science output (1868 per turn), but still it might take 30+ turns total. However, the free tech from Great Leap Forward could cut one, but that's 19 turns away. We might be able to get a great scientist to bulb a tech? We have 2 great engineers used, no great scientists mentioned. We are generating great person points, but not sure when next will come.
We need to accelerate research. Our current flavors: Science 30. We might want to increase science flavor to prioritize research buildings and specialists. But we are in a defensive crisis. We also have gold (514, +347 per turn) that we can use to buy research labs or universities? Actually, we can't buy buildings with gold unless we have the appropriate policy. But we can rush-buy units to defend.
